description:
## About Hack For Tomorrow

Hack For Tomorrow is the flagship 24-hour intercollegiate hackathon of Excel, the annual techno-managerial fest of Govt. Model Engineering College (MEC), Kochi. Bringing together aspiring developers, innovators, and problem-solvers from across the country, it provides a collaborative platform to transform ideas into impactful technological solutions.

This edition embraces the theme **Beyond Intelligence: Why Cognition Matters in an AI-First World**, encouraging participants to look beyond conventional artificial intelligence .In association with **YE Stack – The Cognition Company**, our Cognition Challenge Partner, the hackathon challenges participants to identify real-world problems and engineer meaningful solutions that push the boundaries of intelligent technology.

Over 24 hours of innovation and collaboration, participants will work alongside fellow developers, explore challenging problem statements, and transform their ideas into functional prototypes
Join us for an experience where ideas meet engineering, challenges inspire creativity, and innovation goes beyond the ordinary.

**January 2–3, 2027**

hackathon_faqs.answer: It's free! No hidden charges, just ideas, code, and innovation.
hackathon_faqs.question: How much is the registration fee?

hackathon_faqs.answer: You can brainstorm and create wireframes beforehand, but the actual project must be built during the hackathon.
hackathon_faqs.question: Can I work on my idea before the hackathon?

hackathon_faqs.answer: Don't worry about hunger pangs! We've got you covered with food and refreshments.
hackathon_faqs.question: What about food?

hackathon_faqs.answer: Absolutely! No experience needed. Bring your curiosity, and we'll take it from there.
hackathon_faqs.question: I'm a beginner, can I participate?

hackathon_faqs.answer: Just reach out to the organizing team. We're happy to help!
hackathon_faqs.question: What if I have more questions?

hackathon_faqs.answer: No. Registration is the first stage of the selection process. All registered participants are expected to attend the keynote session, followed by an idea submission and shortlisting process. Only shortlisted teams will be eligible to participate in the 24-hour hackathon.
hackathon_faqs.question: Does registering for Hack For Tomorrow guarantee participation in the hackathon?

hackathon_faqs.answer: Yes. The keynote session is an integral part of the event and will introduce participants to the theme, Beyond Intelligence: Why Cognition Matters in an AI-First World, and provide insights into the problem areas to be explored.
hackathon_faqs.question: Is attending the keynote session mandatory?

hackathon_faqs.answer: Following the keynote session, registered participants will receive an email containing the idea submission guidelines, instructions, and deadline. Participants are expected to submit their ideas within the specified timeline.
hackathon_faqs.question: How will the idea submission process work?

hackathon_faqs.answer: Teams will be evaluated based on their understanding of the problem, technical depth, feasibility of the proposed solution, relevance to the cognition theme, and potential for measurable impact. Shortlisted teams will be notified through their registered email addresses.
hackathon_faqs.question: How will teams be shortlisted?
